plugins.name: orangu
plugins.description: Improve your agent harness and your setup. The brain, /orangu:improve, finds patterns in your local Claude Code, Cowork and Desktop sessions and proposes changes. It applies only the changes that you approve by id, and orangu checks each one on your later sessions. The measurement uses no model, needs no account and uploads nothing.
